asks.author: rm-role-designer-1794718990
asks.decision: whether the first move is a live walk of what is built, and who watches it
asks.text: Graffiti is already built and its loop reported all 22 north-star bars proven on 2026-11-08 (two of those claims are still open: whether the vandal art still carries Earth-style signs, and that the proof lives in a loop clone the pipeline cannot rerun), so before any new design we propose a live walk of what exists: a lived-in colony save after several in-game weeks on ordinary walls, with a painting spree, recreation tagging, a raid's exit tags and a trader visit, and the shipped vandal marks at play zoom. It measures what we would otherwise ask you to predict: whether the social layer stays occasional or becomes a mood tax, whether the vandal art still carries Earth-style signs, and scrawl versus tally on a lived-in wall, which you asked to see again. Which way: (a) you watch it with us in one sitting, (b) an agent walks it and brings you a short set of zoomed shots, or (c) not now, argue the root first?

review.why: the owner-requested live walk; names what it settles, asks no prediction, answerable (a)/(b)/(c); proof wording softened to name the two open contradictions

asks.author: rm-role-designer-1794718990
asks.decision: the root text of the Graffiti concept (stage 1 ends on his approval of it)
asks.text: Proposed root, in one sentence: "Graffiti turns a colony's walls into a record of its people: punk tags and ideoligion sigils whose quality comes from the painter's art skill, and marks about people (mockery, tribute, memorials, insults) that move mood, opinion and now and then a confrontation, all readable at play zoom in any RimWorld game." Our strongest doubt about it: in a real colony it may play as a decal pack with mood numbers attached, either the social layer almost never fires or it becomes a permanent mood tax, and only the walk can tell which. Is this the root, or which word would you change?

review.why: stage-1 root not yet answered by his words, answerable in a phrase, claims match the inventory, the doubt is left to the walk

asks.author: rm-role-designer-1794718990
asks.decision: which showcase is Graffiti's face (showcase 1 must be his pick)
asks.text: Which scene should be Graffiti's face, the first showcase a player sees? (A) A lived-in colony wall: a mockery naming someone, a reply painted over it, a confrontation. (B) A spree corridor: one pawn's break leaving many visibly different punk marks, a skilled piece beside an ugly scrawl. (C) After a raid: the raiders' exit tags troubling the colony until the wall is retaken. The walk would show all three, so you can also answer after it.

review.why: showcase 1 must be his pick, taste not measurement, changes which scene is built; 'and scrubbed' removed (inv_raid_marks says retaking ends it)

contradictions.text: The loop's close (2026-11-08, b967d9e9cb) says all 22 bars are proven, including mark_carries_no_earth_signage. GRAFFITI_VANDAL_REDRAW_TWO_SIGNS_GONE_LEGIT (still proposed) and GRAFFITI_NORTHSTAR_GREEN_FULL_1 (BLOCKED, last 2026-11-06, before the landing) say vandal_0 (hazard bolt) and vandal_1 (prohibition sign) fail it. Unsettled: whether the landed art still carries them. Settle by looking at the shipped vandal_0/vandal_1 (a measurement, not a question for him).

The 22 bars were proven in the loop clone (ralph/DONE.md on branch ralph/graffiti, evidence on D:\ClaudeWork), but the mod's own script claims none of 12 validated must-show lines, so modcheck refuses every Graffiti run and SteveDesktop records INVALID jobs. Proven once by hand is not re-provable by the pipeline: a build item at stage 3, not a question.

northstar_site.py preflight checks 6 settings at shipped defaults; the mod has 8 (socialEnabled, socialMessagesEnabled unchecked), so a site with the social layer off passes preflight. Script gap for stage 3.

failure_modes: Proven once, unprovable after: the 22 bars were proven by hand in a loop clone, while the mod's own script claims none of 12 must-show lines, so every pipeline run is refused and any later change to Graffiti (the Star Wars reskin, a race trait, an engine fix) ships with nothing able to say whether it broke the wall.

It reads as dirt or Earth signage, not punk graffiti: the face of the mod is the art at play zoom; a hazard bolt or prohibition sign, tidy pictograms, or a mark that is mush at 64 px makes it look like a decal pack, and the stat (beauty, skill) disagrees with the picture.

The social layer becomes a tax or noise in a real colony: proven on staged sites over short runs, never in a lived-in colony across weeks, so mood, opinion and grudges may stack into a permanent mood tax, a message stream, or fights from nothing; and personality and visitor rules quietly stop matching when race traits arrive.
